attributes.text: Blake Ward & Boky Hackel Exploring human essence through figurative sculpture
Pushing the figure into the 21st century

attributes.altText: Portrait of the sculptor Blake Ward

attributes.text: Canadian-born and working from Monaco, Blake has spent four decades on the human figure. Classically educated, he quickly began deconstructing his knowledge through the Fragments and Spirits Collections. His partial bronzes ask what remains of a body once the inessential is removed.
Exploring the mysteries of time and being

attributes.altText: Portrait of the sculptor Boky Hackel

attributes.text: Born in Rheinfelden, Germany, she quickly moved to central America; her youth lit by the Venezuelan Sun and and Boky works in steel, light and gold leaf. Her sculptures turn inward focusing on memory, fracture and what endures.
In Lucem · Figurative Poetry · Silentium Aurum
